why: The Wikipedia 'Open coloring axiom' article states 'recently Gilton and Neeman have announced that OCA[ARS] does not imply c = ℵ₂', and Gilton-Neeman's paper (arXiv:1904.10516, JML 2021, pre-snapshot) built a model of OCA_ARS with 2^ℵ₀=ℵ₃; I could not confidently tell whether this addresses OCA_T (Todorčević's axiom, the one most sources call simply 'OCA' and the likely intended target of this bullet) or only the ARS variant, nor pin down whether a Gilton-Neeman result specifically for OCA_T/full OCA postdates or predates the snapshot.
queries: OCA open coloring axiom consistent 2^aleph_0 greater aleph_2
"Open Coloring Axiom" Todorcevic large continuum open problem consistent 2024 2025
Open coloring axiom wikipedia OCA large continuum
Gilton Neeman OCA large continuum consistent aleph_2 announcement

found.title: Open coloring axiom
found.note: Article states Gilton and Neeman announced OCA[ARS] does not imply c = ℵ₂; unclear if this note predates or postdates the Jan 2024 snapshot or bears on OCA_T specifically.

found.title: Abraham-Rubin-Shelah Open Colorings and a Large Continuum
found.note: Pre-snapshot paper by Gilton and Neeman constructing a model of OCA_ARS with 2^ℵ₀=ℵ₃; concerns the ARS variant, not clearly OCA_T.

found.title: Open Colorings and Baumgartner's Axiom
found.note: Recent preprint proving MA_ℵ1+OCA_T consistent with Baumgartner's Axiom and OCA_ARS both failing; appears related to OCA_T but about a different question (Baumgartner's Axiom), not the continuum size.
